generations.name: Gen 1 (2022-2024)
generations.notes: Launch on 2170 cells: Standard (~105 kWh), Large (~128.9 kWh usable) and Max (~141.5 kWh) packs, Dual and Quad motor; CCS1 port; DC peak about 200-220 kW (general knowledge, not checked on a cited page). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/722131/second-gen-rivian-r1-debut/

generations.name: Gen 2 (2025 on)
generations.notes: Second-generation R1 unveiled June 6, 2024 as MY2025: new electrical architecture and motors; Standard pack becomes LFP (~92.5 kWh usable), Large ~109.4 kWh usable (53G cells), Max ~141.5 kWh; Dual, Tri and Quad motor. Whether a native NACS port arrives on R1 in a later year was not checked. Confidence: high for the boundary, medium for pack figures (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/722131/second-gen-rivian-r1-debut/ ; https://stories.rivian.com/meet-the-new-r1 ; https://www.greencarreports.com/news/1143421_2025-rivian-r1t-r1s-ev-lfp-review
